name: momentum-crypto-rw10-turtle-long-pure-v1
description: PRE-REGISTERED (2026-11-02) BEFORE any run, RW §21 candidate B. DRY-RUN ONLY, NOT EXECUTED. Exact live RW8 b37681ff control plus ONLY Turtle System 2 LONG breakout units on the same eight coins: hourly close strictly above the highest high of the prior 55 completed UTC days; exit below the prior 20 daily lows, at fill-minus-2N or after 120h. Wilder ATR20, 1N=1% sleeve equity, one unit per coin, no pyramiding, no native intraday stop, fresh below-to-above channel crossing after expiry. Source: Curtis Faith, Original Turtle Trading Rules, System 2, https://www.tradingwithrayner.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/OriginalTurtleRules.pdf. Same-symbol TSM longs take priority and never adopt a Turtle unit; long and short Turtle units never coexist on a coin. Other positions can coexist under unchanged shared gross/margin caps; Turtle units are not vt35-scaled or resized. Published six-unit correlated-market cap is not replicated, as in the live short leg. Criterion C (RW §19.3, §21): CAGR >= 0, orders/day above the control, four-sleeve account drawdown <= 35%; highest CAGR among qualifying candidates. Sleeve drawdown is reported as a cost, not a 40% veto. Data source/cuts/asOf/universe/costs/folds/capital/acceptance and the existing breakoutShort remain unchanged. Trial 476 -> 477. No tuning, historical trial, live activation or model-key change.
